title: Same-State Pairs Make One JEPA Proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis Vacuous
abstract: arXiv:2611.16182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), the JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) assumes that every observation determines the world state and that a spectral gap makes minimizers unique up to rotation. Under the hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity: every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, and, when $d_z-1\ge 2k$, two minimizers can have best-rotation squared residual $2k$. translated_title: 同状态样本对使柏拉图表示假说的一种JEPA证明变得空洞
translated_abstract: 在联合嵌入预测架构中，JEPA对柏拉图表示假说的证明假设每个观测都能确定世界状态，并且谱间隙使得极小值点在旋转意义下唯一。本文证明，在硬白化总体目标下，同状态正样本对会使诱导出的世界核成为恒等核：每一个中心化的白化状态函数都是全局极小值点，并且当 $d_z-1\ge 2k$ 时，两个极小值点之间的最优旋转平方残差可以达到 $2k$。该唯一性断言是有条件的；对于 $k……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明，在JEPA的硬白化总体目标下，同状态正样本对会使诱导的世界核退化为恒等核，导致所有中心化白化状态函数都是全局极小值点，从而使JEPA对柏拉图表示假说证明中的极小值唯一性断言变得空洞失效。
en_tdlr: Under JEPA's hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity, so every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, rendering the uniqueness claim in one JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis vacuous.
